d: This teenager with a slender yet curvaceous build has dusty rose hair styled in a high side ponytail with long, sweeping bangs and a soft texture. The eyes are a muted grey with a neutral, wide expression. Wearing a white long-sleeved ribbed shirt under a dark grey high-waisted skirt with black suspenders and a matching dark grey belt, the outfit is topped with a dark grey peaked cap featuring the number "51" on the front. Signature details include a small silver star earring and a large, grey naval turret apparatus attached to the back.
